authority: derived view; the canonical disposition recorded by prometheus kbd phase close is authoritative

scenarios.name: Baseline suite still collected and green
scenarios.actor: Contributor running the project test command
scenarios.usefulOutcome: The configured test command runs and every baseline test still passes, with only justified test-file changes
limitations: does not prove performance on production hardware

scenarios.name: SQLite behaviour unchanged after the backend split
scenarios.usefulOutcome: State operations on SQLite return the same results as before
limitations: does not cover the dashboard UI

scenarios.name: Postgres 18 matches the same expectations
scenarios.usefulOutcome: State operations on Postgres 18 behave exactly like SQLite, including signal governance

scenarios.name: Migrations reverse cleanly and the runtime role cannot change schema
scenarios.actor: Hosted operator upgrading or rolling back
scenarios.usefulOutcome: Schema changes can be undone and the running app cannot alter the schema
limitations: does not test data-preserving down migrations beyond schema

scenarios.name: Concurrent claimers send an approved item once
scenarios.usefulOutcome: An approved email is sent exactly once even when the heartbeat and dashboard race
limitations: concurrency is simulated in one host, not across pods

scenarios.name: Sending safety identical on Postgres
scenarios.actor: A prospect and the sender's domain reputation
scenarios.usefulOutcome: Quiet hours, daily limit, opt-out and approval ladder behave the same on both backends
limitations: real mailbox delivery is not exercised
substitutedBoundaries: the outbound mailbox is a recording test double; no email leaves the machine

scenarios.name: A fixture database moves intact
scenarios.actor: An operator moving from local to hosted
scenarios.usefulOutcome: An existing SQLite database lands in Postgres with nothing lost
limitations: the operator's real database is not moved

scenarios.name: Only the allowlisted identity reaches the hosted dashboard
scenarios.usefulOutcome: The operator gets in through Kratos and flint-gate; nobody else gets anything
limitations: the public hostname and TLS are not exercised (carried CG-2)

scenarios.name: Local token mode unchanged
scenarios.usefulOutcome: Local installs keep the token link and refuse public binds
limitations: does not exercise MCP agent clients

scenarios.name: No secrets in logs; locked-down runtime
scenarios.actor: An operator whose cluster logs are widely readable
scenarios.usefulOutcome: Neither the dashboard token nor the Claude credential leaks, and the runtime is non-root and read-only
limitations: cluster log pipeline itself not exercised

scenarios.name: AI credential from the environment only
scenarios.actor: The operator running the hosted brain
scenarios.usefulOutcome: The brain authenticates from the Secret-provided variable without persisting it
limitations: provider terms for headless subscription use are the operator's risk and are not tested
substitutedBoundaries: no real inference call unless the operator supplies a token; without it that sub-check is BLOCKED

scenarios.name: Guarded digest pin and hardened manifests
scenarios.usefulOutcome: A merge produces a scanned image and a guarded pin with no real hostname in this fork
limitations: no real GitHub Actions run, registry push or cluster sync
substitutedBoundaries: the platform repository is replaced by a scratch fixture repository; live run and Argo CD sync are NOT_EXERCISED (carried CG-1)

scenarios.name: Platform interface contract published and well-formed
scenarios.usefulOutcome: Both repositories can build against one agreed interface
limitations: agreement by the platform repository's own phase is outside this contract
